EHDSImagingReport.body.examinationReport.conclusion.conditionOrFinding[x] 0..*Condition or finding from imaging investigation.
EHDSImagingReport.body.examinationReport.conclusion.conditionOrFinding[x].conditionOrFindingEHDSConditionEHDSCondition
EHDSImagingReport.body.examinationReport.conclusion.conditionOrFinding[x].conditionOrFindingEHDSObservationEHDSObservation

EHDSImagingReport.body.recommendation.description 1..1stringNarrative description of the recommended activities including additional investigation, medication etc.
EHDSImagingReport.body.recommendation.carePlan 0..*EHDSCarePlanA complex and structured information about recommended goals, activities and objectives in the form of one or more formal care plan to be implemented after this imaging investigation.
EHDSImagingReport.body.comparisonStudy 0..*EHDSImagingReportDocumentation (reference) of a prior Imaging Report to which the current images were compared.
EHDSImagingReport.dicomStudyMetadata 0..*EHDSImagingStudyMetadata of the DICOM study. A study comprises a set of series, each of which includes a set of Service-Object Pair Instances (SOP Instances - images or other data) acquired or produced in a common context.
